title: Entrance Fee Agreement Price Schedule by Refund Plan
content:
Larkspur Life Plan sales schedule for the **Entrance Fee Agreement**. Six refund plans are offered. Each plan carries a contract type, a plan multiplier applied to the base entrance fee of the apartment type, a rounding increment for the priced fee and a fixed entrance fee for a second resident under the same agreement.

## Plan terms

| Refund plan | Contract type | Entrance fee multiplier | Second person entrance fee (USD) | Rounding increment (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| LifeChoice Declining Balance Plan | fee-for-service | 1.0 | 25000.00 | 100 |
| LifeChoice 50% Refundable Plan | fee-for-service | 1.31 | 32750.00 | 100 |
| LifeChoice 75% Refundable Plan | fee-for-service | 1.47 | 36750.00 | 100 |
| LifeChoice 90% Refundable Plan | fee-for-service | 1.66 | 41500.00 | 100 |
| LifeCare Declining Balance Plan | lifecare | 1.24 | 31000.00 | 100 |
| LifeCare 90% Refundable Plan | lifecare | 1.98 | 49500.00 | 100 |

A fee-for-service contract provides future care at market rates with a discount; a lifecare contract largely covers future care fees. The rounding increment is applied half up.

## Base entrance fee by apartment type (single occupancy)

The base entrance fee is the declining-balance fee-for-service price of the apartment type. The same base schedule stands under all six refund plans.

| Independent living apartment type | Base entrance fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| Independent Living Studio | 168500.00 |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom | 231900.00 |
| Independent Living One-Bedroom Deluxe | 276400.00 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom | 342800.00 |
| Independent Living Two-Bedroom Deluxe | 405300.00 |
| Independent Living Cottage Home | 519700.00 |

## Notes to the schedule

- The multiplier and the second person fee belong to the refund plan; the base fee belongs to the apartment type. Neither column varies with the campus.
- The LifeChoice Declining Balance Plan carries a multiplier of 1.0, so its price for an apartment type equals the base fee of that type before rounding.
- The second person entrance fee is a fixed amount per plan, not a percentage of the first resident's fee.
